title: Product of Experts for Visual Generation
claim: Combining a graphics-engine asset with a text prompt lets one controllable pipeline insert varied objects realistically into diverse scenes.
layout: 3x4 image grid; first column input images, columns labeled by asset and prompt
description: A 3-row by 4-column grid of photographs. The left column shows three original scenes: a pickup truck kicking up mud in a field, an Easter card and chocolate eggs on a glass table, and cows in a meadow with a tree. The other three columns show the same scenes with an inserted object. Above each of these columns is a flat-shaded 3D asset labeled 'Graphics Engine Input': a brown box, the same brown box, and a pink cylinder. Captions below the columns read 'Input Image', '+ "metal box"', '+ "glass box"' and '+ "coke can"'. The inserted objects blend into each scene with matching reflections, transparency and lighting. The same box geometry becomes either metal or glass depending on the text prompt. The eye goes first to the inserted objects.
caption: Application on Image Object Insertion where the goal is to insert assets posed in a graphics engine (top row) and described with text prompts (bottom row) into images (first column).
abstract: Modern neural models capture rich priors and have complementary knowledge over shared data domains, e.g., images and videos. Integrating diverse knowledge from multiple sources -- including visual generative models, visual language models, and sources with human-crafted knowledge such as graphics engines and physics simulators -- remains under-explored. We propose a Product of Experts (PoE) framework that performs inference-time knowledge composition from heterogeneous models. This training-free approach samples from the product distribution across experts via Annealed Importance Sampling (AIS). Our framework shows practical benefits in image and video synthesis tasks, yielding better controllability than monolithic methods and additionally providing flexible user interfaces for specifying visual generation goals.
